decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Reason for Approval

It is considered that the proposed side and rear infill extension, by way of its location, design and appearance, has due regard for the sites characteristics and the dynamics of the surrounding built environment and will not be detrimental to the general or traffic related amenity of the adjoining properties or the immediate locality.  It is in line with the sites existing business use and is deemed to be in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and T.4.3 (Traffic Implications of New Development) of The London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
description: Erection of single storey side/rear infill extension to existing retail unit.
